Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Frédéric Bastiat (author, Wikidata Q13515), died 1850; Patrick James Stirling (translator, Wikidata Q18910599), died 1896. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bastiat, Frédéric, 1801-1850; Stirling, Patrick James, 1809-1891 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's (Wikidata gives some of them several death years, every one 1925 or earlier: Patrick James Stirling [1891, 1896]).

Printed edition: Harmonies of political economy, Edinburgh : Oliver and Boyd, [1880], the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/harmoniesofpolit00bastiala. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 100%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
